title: Draykop the Amazon
description: Draykop the Amazon — Townston and HDoL vendor, Draykop's Crypt
html:
Draykop the Amazon (some of us just call her the Amazonian) appeared in Build 130 with the Bling Gnome. She is a merchant. She stands in Townston pushing the retail box, and she also keeps a second shop in Horrific Dungeon of Legend so you do not have to run back to town just to dump loot.

She sells very high quality Items, some yellows, mostly purples and occasionally a rainbow. They are divided into Low, Medium, High, and Max. Prices are high but not outrageous. She also buys loot, and as of Build 138 it appears that she offers approximately 10% more for purple and rainbow loot than the other merchants.

Contents

  • 1 Townston
  • 2 Draykop's Crypt
  • 3 The Shop
  • 4 Quotes

Townston

Her town stall is the one with the bookseller pitch. Click her and she will talk your ear off about swollen feet, Gwen's tofu casserole, and how every woman needs a Bling Gnome. Then she hands you a link to the well known online bookseller so you can buy the retail box. Same shop tabs as the dungeon. Same stingy prices. Same extra gold when you sell her purples and rainbows.

Draykop's Crypt

Yes, she is in HDoL. The group dungeon entrance is on the highest part of Townston, by Tilles the Sellout. That entrance level is the usual packed Catacombs mess. Off to one side is a portal into a little private crypt named Draykop's Crypt.

It is still HDoL. Levels 25 to 100, death penalty, rez sickness, you drop back in Townston if you die. Do not treat it like a safe vendor room.

The Amazon Gatekeeper stands in front of the Amazon Door. He looks like a Raythe, swings a haste sword, and likes to knock you around. He brings friends: a couple of Heroes plus extras. The pack changes. Shadow Reavers, fire or ice Fades, poison Blademasters, shadow Oroks. Hero loot when he drops. The door says The Amazon Door is locked. until he dies, then The Amazon Door is open!

Past the door is her shop. Carts, bags, a table, the works. She will tell you the town was too crowded and this dungeon is more her style.

The Shop

Four tabs. Anybody can make the purchase. The level of the items is what it is.

Tab Item levels
Low25–49
Medium50–74
High75–99
Max100


Yellows, mostly purples, the odd rainbow. In the crypt the shelves do not restock. What she has is what she has until the instance goes away. If you are farming Lower Cindercore and your bags are exploding, this is closer than running Tilles and the town merchants.

Quotes

"Why hello there! The town was too crowded! This dungeon is more my style." (Draykop's Crypt)

"Why hello there! All of this standing around in this heat has aggravated my sciatica. Oh, and my feet are like swollen balloons that could pop at any moment." (Townston)

Then she is off about Audrey's birthday, Gwen's tofu, and why you need three Bling Gnomes. You already know how that speech ends.
